text:
maria: heads-up — seeing a p99 token latency regression on gpu-pool-8 starting ~17:03 UTC, +180-240ms relative to baseline. throughput also down ~12%.
jen: link to dashboards?
maria: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/cluster/gpu-pool-8 time=17:00-17:20 :eyes:
kai: quick glance — request distribution shows a tiny tenant spike in prompt length at the same time. single tenant accounts for ~7% of requests but ~40% of tokens/sec. possible noisy neighbor.
sam: also seeing tool-call rate spike from that tenant, repeated external tool invocations (web_fetch -> parse -> web_fetch loop). could be streaming backpressure too.
maria: i pulled runtime profile for a 2 minute window, pasted small snippet below:
```
[PROFILE] selected_kernel=attn_quant_fallback
[PROFILE] avg_attn_ms=1.9 -> 3.6 (+90%)
[PROFILE] kv_cache_evictions/s=420
[PROFILE] avg_tokens_per_req=6 -> 78
[PROFILE] batch_size_tail=1.2 -> 2.8
```
jen: kv cache evictions that high will force repeated recompute of KV and blow perf. are those evictions tenant-isolated or global LRU?
kai: logs show mostly global LRU churn. the long prompts + small batching causes many ephemeral cache entries and eviction noise. also kernel selection heuristics fell back to quantized attention path for long sequence lengths which is slower on this target hw for these shapes.
sam: command i ran to reproduce (local sim):
```
# simulate long prompt + tool loop
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -X POST $RUNTIME/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt_len":12000, "tool_calls":2}' & done
```
maria: mitigation idea: 1) temporarily pin tenant to latency-optimized kernel (force_fp32) 2) bump per-tenant kvcache quota 3) apply short-term ingress rate limit for that tenant 4) tweak batching heuristic to prefer latency (max_batch=16, batching_window_ms=30).
jen: agree. can we hotpatch kernel selection for tenant without full deploy? runtime supports per-tenant kernel hints.
kai: yes — adding config: `tenant_overrides.{TENANT_ID}.kernel_hint=force_fp32`  — will push now as canary to 1 host in pool. also increasing tenant_kvcache_quota from 64MB -> 256MB for the tenant.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: tenant override applied to host gpu-pool-8-12 at 17:14 UTC. status: IN_PROGRESS.
maria: initial health after canary: p99 dropped ~120ms within 60s on that host. overall pool p99 improved ~60ms.
sam: added a temporary rate-limit rule: ingress.rps[tenant]=20 (was unlimited). observed tool-call spike flattening.
jen: open a short-lived alert guard to catch reoccurrence and collect differentials: kernel_choice, kvcache_evictions, avg_prompt_len, tool_calls/s.
kai: creating an incident doc and assigning follow-up items: two action items — (1) permanent kernel heuristic fix for long/short sequences tradeoff, (2) smarter per-tenant kvcache isolation/quotas. i'll own (1), maria owns (2).
maria: noted. i'll also add a small eval to detect tool-calling loops (pattern detector) so we can auto-throttle.
deploy-bot: canary -> pool roll started at 17:25 UTC, hosts updated: gpu-pool-8-{12,13,15}. status: SUCCESS.
jen: nice mitigation. postmortem & perf regression ticket please. assign severity: sev3 for now (customer impact limited).
maria: filing postmortem now and exporting profiler traces. will include quick commands to reproduce and the small kernel selection patch.
kai: thanks all — logging follow-ups in #incidents and tagging infra-team for kernel perf tuning. :thumbsup:
